plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Physics, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 2005S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/catalog/engineering-physical-and-computer-sciences-department/physics/physics-associate-of-science/ . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals). TRUE award: Associate of Science. Total credits: 61, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 61'); semester totals 16/17/16/12 sum exactly. Note: Spring Sophomore is 12 credits per the official catalog (HUMA GE2 + SOCS GE2 + GNED 101 + 3-cr Program Electives). Choice slots: COMM GE / HUMA GE / SOCS GE / WELL GE / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (3 credits each semester; student choice from the program-electives list printed on the page: COMS 229, MATH 230, MATH 275, MATH 310). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page. Footnotes: Humanities and Social Science courses must each be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
